headline: GETTY DRILLS 342m AT 0.50% COPPER FROM 9m DEPTH — HIGHLAND VALLEY PORPHYRY DELIVERS BROAD, SHALLOW RESULT ADJACENT TO NORTH AMERICA'S LARGEST OPEN-PIT COPPER MINE
source_name: Newsfile Corp / Getty Copper Inc. (TSXV: GTC)
snippet: Getty Copper Inc. (TSXV: GTC) released first assay results from its 2026 exploration program on June 22, announcing 342 metres of 0.50% copper from 9 metres depth at Getty North in the Highland Valley District of south-central British Columbia — a district anchored by Teck Resources' Highland Valley Copper mine, North America's largest open-pit copper operation. The 16,000-metre 2026 drill campaign targets both resource definition at Getty North and exploration of new porphyry centres across the district-scale land package. For retail investors tracking TSXV copper porphyry explorers, a 342-metre intercept starting from 9 metres depth in an active Canadian copper district adjacent to world-class production infrastructure delivers the shallow-entry, broad-width geometry that porphyry copper deposits require for open-pit viability — the combination that distinguishes a resource-expansion result from an exploration curiosity.

headline: COPPER GIANT MOCOA MD-064: 1,052m CONTINUOUS MINERALIZATION INCLUDING 486m AT 0.57% CuEq — THIRD PORPHYRY CORRIDOR CONFIRMED AT COLOMBIA'S 1.12-BILLION-TONNE DEPOSIT
source_name: Junior Mining Network / Copper Giant Resources Corp. (TSXV: CGNT)
snippet: Copper Giant Resources Corp. (TSXV: CGNT) released assay results on June 22 from deep infill hole MD-064 and directional daughter hole MD-063 at its Mocoa copper-molybdenum porphyry project in Putumayo, Colombia — with MD-064 intersecting 1,052 metres of continuous mineralization including 486 metres averaging 0.57% CuEq (0.41% Cu and 0.029% Mo), exceeding the current resource model average of 0.51% CuEq and confirming grade continuity below the conceptual pit shell ahead of the planned Preliminary Economic Assessment. The result also delivers the first modern confirmation of the western breccia, establishing a third drill-tested mineralized corridor at a deposit underpinned by a 1.12-billion-tonne inferred resource containing 12.7 billion pounds of CuEq. For retail investors evaluating large-footprint TSXV copper developers, a 1,052-metre intercept beating the resource model grade while simultaneously opening a third corridor defines the drill programs that convert a resource into a pre-feasibility asset.

headline: MAGNA MINING SUDBURY R2 FOOTWALL: 29.7% CuEq OVER 3.4m — 9.4% COPPER, 19.8 g/t GOLD AND 8.8 g/t PGMs AS LEVACK PEA TARGETS Q3 2026 AND SHARES GRADUATE TO TSX
source_name: Junior Mining Network / Magna Mining Inc. (TSX: NICU)
snippet: Magna Mining Inc. (TSX: NICU) announced June 22 that drillhole MLV-26-14A W2 at the Levack Mine in Sudbury Basin's North Range intersected the R2 Footwall Zone grading 29.7% copper equivalent over 3.4 metres — including 9.4% copper, 2.3% nickel, 19.8 g/t gold, 2.8 g/t platinum, 6.0 g/t palladium, and 52.9 g/t silver — as the company advances toward a Levack Preliminary Economic Assessment in Q3 2026 and a restart decision in H2 2026. Magna's common shares simultaneously graduated to the Toronto Stock Exchange, commencing TSX trading under the symbol NICU on June 23. Sudbury footwall zones are characterised by exceptionally high precious metal and PGM grades that carry the bulk of a past-producing mine's revenue stream — and with gold at $4,200 and palladium at $1,289 per ounce on June 22, the per-tonne value of a 29.7% CuEq intercept in the current price environment is among the highest in the project's recorded history.

headline: BLACKROCK WORLD MINING TRUST LEADS C$35M PLACEMENT IN GLADIATOR METALS — WHITEHORSE COPPER PROJECT YUKON TO RUN SIX DRILL RIGS BY LATE SUMMER WITH C$50M TREASURY
source_name: Junior Mining Network / Gladiator Metals Corp. (TSXV: GLAD)
snippet: Gladiator Metals Corp. (TSXV: GLAD) announced June 22 a non-brokered private placement led by BlackRock World Mining Trust — the world's largest dedicated mining equity fund — raising C$35,040,000 through 7,000,000 Charity Flow-Through shares at C$3.87 and 3,000,000 Non-Flow-Through shares at C$2.65, bringing total treasury to C$50 million upon closing on or about July 15, 2026 and fully funding the 2026 and 2027 exploration campaigns at the Whitehorse Copper Project in Yukon. Proceeds enable expansion from 3 to 6 active drill rigs before end of summer; qualifying critical mineral mining expenditures are renounced to subscribers by December 31, 2026. For retail investors tracking TSXV copper explorers, a fully allocated institutional placement led by the world's largest mining-dedicated fund at a defined cornerstone price eliminates financing risk through 2027 and provides a hard institutional benchmark — the category of capital certainty that distinguishes drill programs that sustain momentum from those that stall between rounds.

headline: HANNAN FIRST HOLE COLLARED 12 DAYS AFTER DEAL SIGNED — STAVATRÄSK GOLD DRILLING BEGINS IN SWEDEN'S BOLIDEN DISTRICT WITH 93 g/t Au AT SURFACE
source_name: Junior Mining Network / Hannan Metals Ltd. (TSXV: HAN)
snippet: Hannan Metals Ltd. (TSXV: HAN) announced June 22 that its diamond drill rig has mobilized and the first hole has been collared at the Stavaträsk gold project in Sweden's Skellefteå Mining District — just 12 days after Hannan secured option rights over three high-grade Swedish gold projects on June 10, 2026. Stavaträsk sits 20 kilometres north of the Boliden deposit, which produced approximately 4.24 million ounces of gold at a historical grade of 15.9 g/t. Surface sampling has returned outcrop grades of up to 93 g/t Au and 24 g/t Ag, with a float boulder field 650 metres southeast grading up to 11.2 g/t Au, 154 g/t Ag, and 2.43% Cu. The initial 1,000-metre program will be followed immediately by a second 1,000-metre campaign upon assay review. For retail investors tracking TSXV-listed European gold explorers, mobilising from option to first hole in 12 days signals a drill-ready target rather than a prospect requiring years of surface preparation before the first assay.

headline: CAPITAN SILVER CRACKS OPEN FRESNILLO CONCESSIONS — NEW PERMIT ADDS UNTESTED STRIKE AT CRUZ DE PLATA AS MEXICO SILVER PROGRAM TARGETS 60,000m IN 2026
source_name: Yahoo Finance / Capitan Silver Corp. (TSXV: CAPT)
snippet: Capitan Silver Corp. (TSXV: CAPT) received a key exploration permit on June 22 for its Cruz de Plata silver-gold project in Durango, Mexico, unlocking drill access to concessions recently acquired from Minera Fresnillo S.A. de C.V. — expanding beyond the previously permitted 2.5-kilometre Jesus María Silver Trend into ground to the east, northwest, and north that has received no modern drilling. Cruz de Plata's best historical intercept is 1,071 g/t AgEq over 2.0 metres within a wider 15.8-metre interval grading 250 g/t AgEq; the 2026 program targets 60,000 metres of multi-rig drilling. Concessions originating from Fresnillo — Mexico's largest primary silver producer — carry geological credibility because Fresnillo voluntarily surrenders exploration ground in Durango's silver belt only when prioritising capital elsewhere, not when abandoning a geological concept.

headline: FOCUS GRAPHITE FILES 120 Mt AT 10.27% Cg AT LAC TETEPISCA — 14.7 MILLION TONNES CONTAINED GRAPHITE POSITIONS QUÉBEC PROJECT AMONG WORLD'S LARGEST BATTERY ANODE DEPOSITS
snippet: Focus Graphite Inc. (TSXV: FMS) filed its NI 43-101 technical report with SEDAR+ on June 22 for the updated mineral resource estimate at the Lac Tetepisca graphite project in Québec, defining 120.16 million tonnes of indicated resources at 10.27% graphitic carbon (Cg) and 24.14 million tonnes of inferred resources at 9.88% Cg — approximately 14.7 million tonnes of contained in-situ graphite, placing Lac Tetepisca among the largest identified graphite deposits globally. The MRE was completed by IOS Services Géoscientifiques using 150 drill holes totaling 26,095 metres, effective April 30, 2026. Natural graphite is the primary anode material in lithium-ion batteries and faces the same western supply chain vulnerability as rare earths: China controls over 70% of global graphite processing capacity, and North American and European battery manufacturers require domestically sourced graphite anode material that only projects like Lac Tetepisca — operating in a stable jurisdiction with existing infrastructure — can supply at the scale required by the EV manufacturing buildout.

headline: KITCO SWOT: TETHER JOINS TOP-20 GOLD HOLDERS WITH 154 TONNES — CRYPTO STABLECOIN GIANT NOW RIVALS EASTERN EUROPEAN CENTRAL BANKS AS INSTITUTIONAL GOLD BUYER
snippet: Kitco's weekly Gold SWOT analysis for June 22, 2026 highlights that Tether — issuer of USDT, the world's largest stablecoin — has accumulated 154 tonnes of gold including its XAUT gold-backed token holdings, placing it among the top 20 official gold holders globally alongside central banks and sovereign wealth funds and establishing a structurally new category of institutional gold demand outside the traditional banking system. The analysis also identifies central bank purchases as the week's key strength, with Scotia Bank estimating 650 tonnes of net buying in 2026 and embedding a 30% risk premium above fundamental fair value into its gold price model on that basis. Aya Gold & Silver's addition to the VanEck GDX ETF effective June 19 is flagged as a near-term institutional liquidity catalyst. For retail investors, Tether's 154-tonne position and 650 tonnes of projected central bank buying represent a combined non-Western, non-ETF demand floor that operates independently of the retail sentiment cycle currently driving the post-ATH correction.
